metadata.description: Private agentPacks plugins. Generated from the portable Agent Plugins source.

plugins.name: delivery-loop
plugins.description: Runs a change through plan, implement, verify and review as separate roles, with an OWASP security gate, a bounded fix round, and a hand-off that stops short of committing: no agent commits, merges or pushes.

plugins.name: dotnet
plugins.description: Formats a C# file the moment an agent writes it, so the diff a human reviews is already formatted and formatting never turns up as a review finding.
